FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Price Holds Above MA20 Amid Hawkish Fed Expectations
tldr_points: USD/JPY trades above the 20‑day MA at 157.87, signaling near‑term bullish momentum.
RSI‑14 at 80.3 indicates overbought conditions, warranting caution for a short‑term pullback.
Fed focus on inflation and steady labor market supports USD strength, while risk‑on equity sentiment weighs on the JPY.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY holds above MA20 RSI overbought; hawkish Fed outlook and risk‑on bias support upside despite short pullback risk
FX.comment: Price above MA20 with hawkish Fed support; look for dip‑buy toward moving average.
